resources.name: Perovskite catalytic properties database (Jacobs et al., 2023)

access.notes: Public dataset from the supplementary information of arXiv:2310.17744 or associated Figshare repository. Contains 749 data points with compositions, target properties (k*, D*, k_chem, D_chem, ASR), DFT O p-band center values, electrolyte types, and measurement years.

resources.name: MAST-ML (MAterials Simulation Toolkit for Machine Learning)

access.notes: Open-source Python package for ML in materials science. Provides feature generation and model training/evaluation routines.
